name: Stowed
tagline: Finds lost bags by image matching and shows when the cabin's overhead space is full.

awards: Third Place for American Airlines Challenge

problem: Lost luggage and carry-on chaos stress travellers.
solution: AI image matching identifies bags without tags, and carry-ons logged at check-in predict overhead capacity.
demo_moment: Team-described: find a bag by photo and see cabin capacity.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Third Place for American Airlines Challenge” among 176 submissions.

lessons: One personal travel mishap makes a sponsor pitch real.
